title: A Song for the King
lines: Ben is a king. He has a red cap.
But Ben can not sing well at all.
When he sings, his dogs run off.
Ben sits on a log. He is sad.
A bug with a red wing sits on him.
The bug sang a long song for Ben.
Ben and the bug sang a long song.
The dogs sat back. Then a dog sang as well.
Ben sings a lot. His dogs sing with him.

questions.ask: What do the dogs do when Ben sings on his own?
questions.listenFor: They run off. It is in the third line - have your child find the word dogs.

questions.ask: Who asks Ben to sing along?
questions.listenFor: The bug with the red wing. Line seven is the bug talking - have them find the quote marks.

questions.ask: Why do you think the dogs sat back that time?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You want a reason tied to the story, like "the song was better with two of them."
